products.reason_for_recall: Handy Seafood states that they are initiating this recall of Blue Crab Cake Mini, Mini Crab Cakes due to Milk (due to Butter in the ingredient statement) and Anchovies (in the Worcestershire Sauce) were not declared in the allergens statement on the package.
